name: spec-architect
description: The six-stage spec pipeline for Claude Code. spec-constitution sets the repository's rules, spec-architect writes the spec and its acceptance criteria, spec-tasks turns it into an ordered list, spec-implement executes one task at a time verifying each against the criteria it cites, spec-drift audits whether the code still does what the spec says, and spec-refactor audits whether it can still be changed — proposing structural work that preserves every criterion rather than closing a new one. Refactoring runs are numbered directories under docs/refactorings/ with a permanent smell registry, mirroring how change proposals are versioned under docs/changes/, and spec-drift closes both out — verifying, recording and archiving finished work of either kind. The AC-### identifiers are what join them: assigned once, cited by every later stage.
